requirementSummary: When a Cooling Package is entered, the system runs calculations to populate the Cooling Circuits, sets the DX Coil Height to the sum of all Circuit heights, and updates this total whenever a Circuit Height is edited, reflecting the new sum in the DX Coil Information.
businessRules: Entering a Cooling Package runs calculations and populates the Cooling Circuits.
The DX Coil Height is calculated as the sum of the heights of all populated Cooling Circuits.
When a user alters a Circuit Height, the form must recalculate the sum of all Circuit heights and update the Height field in DX Coil Information.
developerConsiderations: Implement logic to sum Circuit heights and populate DX Coil Height on initial calculation and on any Circuit Height edit.
ambiguities: Valid height ranges and precision are unspecified.
The source and format of starting circuit values are unspecified.
Behavior when circuits are added or removed is unspecified.

ambiguityResolutions.rationale: The ticket specifies that the heights are summed to produce the DX Coil Height.
ambiguityResolutions.sourceQuote: Then we sum the height for each Circuit to make the value that is to appear in the DX Coil Information.
